name: event_date
description: Date the disaster event started as recorded in EM-DAT

name: event_date_precision
description: Precision level of the event date recorded by EM-DAT (exact day vs month-level estimate)

name: date_is_exact
description: Binary flag indicating whether EM-DAT records an exact (not estimated) event date; data-quality control since imprecise dates weaken all date-aligned features and targets

name: disaster_type
description: Raw disaster type string before one-hot encoding (Flood/Storm/Drought/etc.)

name: disaster_group
description: EM-DAT top-level disaster classification group (Natural/Technological)

name: disaster_subgroup
description: EM-DAT disaster subgroup classification (Meteorological/Hydrological/Climatological)

name: financial_damage
description: Reported USD economic damage from EM-DAT; observed for only 18 of 74 events with non-random missingness favouring large/recent/international events

name: damage_source
description: Source or method used to determine the financial damage figure

name: financial_damage_observed
description: Missingness flag for financial_damage (1 = real value reported; 0 = zero-filled); separates unreported damage from genuinely zero damage

name: population_affected
description: Total number of people reported affected by the disaster event in EM-DAT

name: total_deaths
description: Total deaths reported by EM-DAT (distinct from di_deaths_log, which comes from DesInventar)

name: deaths_available
description: Missingness flag for total_deaths; prevents a zero from being confused with unreported

name: no_homeless
description: Number of people left homeless as reported in EM-DAT

name: homeless_available
description: Missingness flag for no_homeless; prevents zero from being confused with unreported

name: mag_area_km2
description: Reported disaster-affected area in square kilometres from EM-DAT

name: mag_wind_kph
description: Reported peak wind speed in km/h from EM-DAT (distinct from hz_wind_max3d, which is independently measured by NASA POWER)

name: mag_area_available
description: Missingness flag for mag_area_km2

name: mag_wind_available
description: Missingness flag for mag_wind_kph

name: dis_no
description: EM-DAT unique disaster identification number

name: event_name
description: Name of the disaster event as recorded in EM-DAT

name: log_financial_damage
description: log1p(financial_damage); compresses multi-order-of-magnitude range of damage figures for modelling

name: log_population_affected
description: log1p(population_affected); compresses range of affected-population figures for modelling

name: disaster_Drought
description: One-hot encoded flag: disaster type is Drought; disaster-type fixed effect for market transmission

name: disaster_Flood
description: One-hot encoded flag: disaster type is Flood; most common event type in sample

name: disaster_Other
description: One-hot encoded flag: disaster type pooled into Other (types with fewer than 3 events, to prevent memorisation)

name: disaster_Storm
description: One-hot encoded flag: disaster type is Storm

name: asof_date
description: Prediction origin date — the point-in-time from which all causal/pre-event features are computed

name: days_since_last_disaster
description: Days elapsed since the previous qualifying disaster event; captures disaster fatigue or compounding-shock effects

name: disasters_trailing_365d
description: Count of qualifying disasters in the trailing 365 days; distinguishes high-frequency-disaster regime from isolated event

name: date
description: Trading date matched to the event (the ASPI trading day on or just after event_date)

name: aspi_close
description: ASPI closing price on the matched trading day; non-stationary so not used as a feature directly

name: trading_volume
description: Raw daily trading volume on the matched trading day

name: price_source
description: Data source identifier for the ASPI price record

name: volume_source
description: Data source identifier for the volume record

name: log_return
description: Day-0 ASPI log return (continuously compounded); base signal from which lagged returns and ratios derive

name: lag_return_t-1
description: 1-day-lagged log return, strictly pre-event (shift applied before any rolling calculation); short-horizon momentum/reversal signal

name: lag_return_t-2
description: 2-day-lagged log return; extends short-horizon momentum/reversal context

name: lag_return_t-3
description: 3-day-lagged log return; extends short-horizon momentum/reversal context

name: lag_return_t-5
description: 5-day-lagged log return; captures whether the pre-event week was trending up or down

name: sma_5
description: 5-day simple moving average of ASPI close; non-stationary raw level not used as feature (price_to_sma_5 used instead)

name: ema_5
description: 5-day exponential moving average of ASPI close; non-stationary raw level not used as feature

name: price_to_sma_5
description: ASPI close divided by 5-day SMA; stationary momentum/deviation-from-trend signal

name: price_to_ema_5
description: ASPI close divided by 5-day EMA; momentum signal that reacts faster to recent days than SMA version

name: sma_10
description: 10-day simple moving average of ASPI close; raw level not used as feature

name: ema_10
description: 10-day exponential moving average of ASPI close; raw level not used as feature

name: price_to_sma_10
description: ASPI close divided by 10-day SMA; medium-horizon momentum/deviation-from-trend signal

name: price_to_ema_10
description: ASPI close divided by 10-day EMA; medium-horizon momentum signal

name: sma_20
description: 20-day simple moving average of ASPI close; raw level not used as feature

name: ema_20
description: 20-day exponential moving average of ASPI close; raw level not used as feature

name: price_to_sma_20
description: ASPI close divided by 20-day SMA; longer-horizon trend-deviation signal (roughly one trading month)

name: price_to_ema_20
description: ASPI close divided by 20-day EMA; longer-horizon trend signal

name: rolling_std_5
description: 5-day realized (backward-looking) return volatility, shift(1)-guarded; short-horizon market turbulence proxy

name: rolling_std_10
description: 10-day realized return volatility; medium-horizon turbulence proxy

name: rolling_std_20
description: 20-day realized return volatility; longer-horizon turbulence proxy (~1 trading month)

name: rolling_std_30
description: 30-day realized return volatility; mirrors the 30-day baseline window used to build Y2 (abnormal volume); panic proxy

name: squared_return
description: Squared same-day log return; cheap, well-known realized-variance proxy complementary to rolling-std features (ARCH family)

name: garch_cond_vol
description: One-step-ahead GARCH(1,1) conditional-volatility forecast (annual-refit, causal by construction); forward-looking signal distinct from backward-looking rolling_std

name: vol_ratio_1_30
description: Day-0 trading volume divided by its own 30-day pre-event baseline; direct 'is trading unusually heavy today' signal

name: vol_ratio_5_30
description: 5-day average volume divided by 30-day baseline; smooths day-0 noise to capture sustained volume shift

name: vol_ratio_10_30
description: 10-day average volume divided by 30-day baseline; longer-horizon volume-regime signal

name: vol_cv_30
description: Coefficient of variation of trading volume over trailing 30 days; captures erratic vs steady trading activity, independent of level

name: log_vol_change_1
description: Log change in trading volume over 1 day; short-horizon volume-momentum signal

name: date_macro
description: Date key used to join annual macroeconomic indicators to daily event records

name: gdp_growth_pct
description: Sri Lanka annual GDP growth percentage; controls for whether disaster hit during expansion or contraction

name: inflation_cpi_pct
description: Sri Lanka annual CPI inflation percentage; controls for macro/economic-crisis conditions independent of the disaster

name: gdp_current_usd
description: Sri Lanka GDP in current USD; used to compute damage_to_gdp ratio but not a feature itself

name: date_gspc
description: Date key used to join S&P 500 returns to event records

name: sp500_log_return
description: S&P 500 day-of log return; global-market-stress proxy distinguishing local disaster reaction from worldwide selloff

name: damage_to_gdp
description: Financial damage normalised by national GDP; sizes disaster relative to the economy, removing currency-inflation and economy-growth effects

name: prediction_origin_session
description: Identifier for which pipeline session built this row; reproducibility tracking

name: P0
description: Day-0 ASPI return on event date; immediate market reaction before forward-looking target windows begin

name: Y1_ASPI_5D_Forward_LogReturn_Pct
description: PRIMARY Y1 TARGET: 5-trading-day forward ASPI log return in percentage points starting from event date

name: Y1_horizon_end_date
description: Calendar date marking the end of the 5-day Y1 forward window

name: Y2_5D_Forward_AbnormalVolume_LogRatio
description: PRIMARY Y2 TARGET: log ratio of 5-day forward average volume to 30-day pre-event baseline volume; measures abnormal trading activity post-disaster

name: Y2_horizon_end_date
description: Calendar date marking the end of the 5-day Y2 forward window

name: Y2_V_base
description: 30-day pre-event baseline average trading volume used as denominator in Y2 computation

name: Y2_V_future5
description: 5-day post-event average trading volume used as numerator in Y2 computation

name: Y3_ASPI_Recovery_Time
description: Y3 TARGET: number of trading days until ASPI recovers to pre-event level after a drawdown; survival/time-to-event outcome

name: Y3_event_observed
description: Binary flag indicating whether the recovery event was actually observed (1) or right-censored (0) during the observation window

name: Y3_censored
description: Binary flag indicating whether the Y3 observation was right-censored (observation window ended before recovery)

name: Y3_censor_reason
description: Text reason for right-censoring (e.g., end of observation window, next disaster intervened)

name: Y3_drawdown_occurred
description: Binary flag indicating whether any drawdown occurred at all after the disaster event; if no drawdown then recovery time is trivially zero

name: Y3_label_end_date
description: Calendar date marking the end of the Y3 observation window

name: Y1_ASPI_1D_Forward_LogReturn_Pct
description: Y1 at 1-day horizon: 1-trading-day forward ASPI log return in percentage points

name: Y1_1D_horizon_end_date
description: End date for the 1-day Y1 horizon

name: Y1_ASPI_10D_Forward_LogReturn_Pct
description: Y1 at 10-day horizon: 10-trading-day forward ASPI log return in percentage points

name: Y1_10D_horizon_end_date
description: End date for the 10-day Y1 horizon

name: Y1_ASPI_15D_Forward_LogReturn_Pct
description: Y1 at 15-day horizon: 15-trading-day forward ASPI log return in percentage points

name: Y1_15D_horizon_end_date
description: End date for the 15-day Y1 horizon

name: Y1_ASPI_20D_Forward_LogReturn_Pct
description: Y1 at 20-day horizon: 20-trading-day forward ASPI log return in percentage points

name: Y1_20D_horizon_end_date
description: End date for the 20-day Y1 horizon

name: Y2_1D_Forward_AbnormalVolume_LogRatio
description: Y2 at 1-day horizon: log ratio of 1-day forward volume to 30-day baseline

name: Y2_1D_horizon_end_date
description: End date for the 1-day Y2 horizon

name: Y2_10D_Forward_AbnormalVolume_LogRatio
description: Y2 at 10-day horizon: log ratio of 10-day forward average volume to 30-day baseline

name: Y2_10D_horizon_end_date
description: End date for the 10-day Y2 horizon

name: Y2_20D_Forward_AbnormalVolume_LogRatio
description: Y2 at 20-day horizon: log ratio of 20-day forward average volume to 30-day baseline

name: Y2_20D_horizon_end_date
description: End date for the 20-day Y2 horizon

name: Y2_5D_Forward_AbnormalVolume_Pct
description: Y2 expressed as percentage change rather than log ratio: (V_future5 / V_base - 1) * 100

name: Y2_5D_Forward_AbnormalVolume_LogRatio_Winsorised
description: Y2 primary target with extreme values winsorised to reduce outlier influence on regression models

name: Y1_ASPI_1D_Forward_AbnormalReturn_Pct
description: Market-model-adjusted abnormal return at 1-day horizon: actual return minus expected return from market model (alpha + beta * S&P500)

name: Y1_1D_abnormal_horizon_end_date
description: End date for 1-day abnormal return horizon

name: Y1_ASPI_5D_Forward_AbnormalReturn_Pct
description: Market-model-adjusted abnormal return at 5-day horizon

name: Y1_5D_abnormal_horizon_end_date
description: End date for 5-day abnormal return horizon

name: Y1_ASPI_10D_Forward_AbnormalReturn_Pct
description: Market-model-adjusted abnormal return at 10-day horizon

name: Y1_10D_abnormal_horizon_end_date
description: End date for 10-day abnormal return horizon

name: Y1_ASPI_15D_Forward_AbnormalReturn_Pct
description: Market-model-adjusted abnormal return at 15-day horizon

name: Y1_15D_abnormal_horizon_end_date
description: End date for 15-day abnormal return horizon

name: Y1_ASPI_20D_Forward_AbnormalReturn_Pct
description: Market-model-adjusted abnormal return at 20-day horizon

name: Y1_20D_abnormal_horizon_end_date
description: End date for 20-day abnormal return horizon

name: market_model_alpha
description: Intercept (alpha) from the market model regression (ASPI ~ S&P500) estimated on pre-event data; used to compute abnormal returns

name: market_model_beta
description: Slope (beta) from the market model regression; measures ASPI's sensitivity to global market movements

name: market_model_n
description: Number of observations used in the market model estimation window

name: hz_precip_max3d
description: Maximum 3-day rainfall accumulation across 7 Sri Lanka district monitoring points; uses max (not mean) because flooding is localised and island average dilutes signal

name: hz_precip_mean3d
description: Mean 3-day rainfall accumulation across districts; island-wide intensity matching the index-level (not sector-level) target

name: hz_precip_spread3d
description: Standard deviation of 3-day rainfall across districts; distinguishes one severely-hit district from uniform island-wide rain at equal mean intensity

name: hz_districts_wet
description: Count of districts exceeding 50mm/3-day rainfall; threshold from Sri Lanka Department of Meteorology's published heavy-rain advisory standard

name: hz_wind_max3d
description: Maximum 3-day 10-metre wind speed across districts; storm-intensity analogue for Storm-type events where wind is the damaging mechanism

name: hz_precip_anom
description: 3-day rainfall anomaly vs location's own trailing-30-day baseline (ends t-3 to avoid overlap); structural parallel to Y2's own V/V_bar construction

name: di_districts_hit
description: Distinct districts with at least one disaster record in a [-7,+14]-day window around the event; geographic breadth of shock

name: di_affected_log
description: log1p(total people affected) in the matched DesInventar window; headcount severity proxy where monetary damage is unavailable

name: di_houses_destroyed_log
description: log1p(total houses destroyed); closest available physical proxy to the missing monetary damage figure (capital destruction)

name: di_houses_damaged_log
description: log1p(total houses damaged, partial loss); partial-loss counterpart to houses_destroyed

name: di_deaths_log
description: log1p(total deaths) in the matched DesInventar window; the most consistently recorded DesInventar severity field

name: di_records
description: Count of DesInventar records in the matched window; explicitly a REPORTING-INTENSITY measure, not a severity one

name: di_available
description: Binary flag: 1 if event matched any DesInventar record, 0 otherwise (coverage ends 2020-12-20); missingness indicator so zero in other di_* columns can be distinguished between confirmed-no-damage and outside-coverage

name: fx_logret_1
description: 1-day USD/LKR log return computed strictly at/before t-1; daily-resolution currency-crisis proxy replacing indefensible annual macro match

name: fx_logret_5
description: 5-day USD/LKR log return; slightly longer FX-instability window than 1-day version

name: fx_vol_30
description: 30-day USD/LKR return volatility; broader currency-instability regime indicator

name: days_to_election
description: Signed days to nearest Sri Lanka national election; controls for known contamination case (2005-11-17 election 4 days before 2005-11-21 event with largest Y1 drop)

name: election_within_5d
description: Binary flag: 1 if absolute value of days_to_election is 5 or fewer; matches the event-window contamination screen

name: log_damage_x_flood
description: Interaction term: log_financial_damage multiplied by the Flood disaster-type flag; tests whether damage-return relationship is flood-specific

name: volume_features_available
description: Binary flag indicating whether trailing volume block could be computed; volume absent for part of early archive, marks imputed vs observed rows

name: garch_cond_vol_available
description: Binary flag indicating whether GARCH conditional volatility forecast existed; first 250 trading days lack sufficient history, missing by construction

name: macro_available
description: Binary flag indicating whether publication-lagged annual macro controls existed for this event year; marks events with imputed macro values
